annotations.title: Build deploy tx (ERC-20 or staking pool)

description: One call to build an UNSIGNED contract-creation tx for a template, with named parameters per template, the predicted address, a simulation (eth_call creation) and verification settings. Never deploys. Use for launching an agent token or a staking pool on Polygon. Polygon only (chain 137).

from.description: Address that will sign and send the txs. Required: used for allowance checks, simulation and nonce.

holder.description: Receives the entire supply at deploy.

supply.description: Total supply in HUMAN units (18 decimals): "1000000" = one million tokens.

template.description: Fixed-supply ERC-20, no owner, no tax.

durationDays.description: Length of each reward period in days, 1-365.

owner.description: Can fund reward periods (Ownable2Step). Cannot touch principal.

rewardToken.description: Token paid as rewards (can equal stakingToken).

name: blazar_build_deploy

outputSchema.description: One-call build: ordered UNSIGNED txs, simulation, guards and warnings. Nothing is signed or sent.

batch.description: EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls request with the same calls (smart wallets).

chainId.description: 137 Polygon, 8453 Base, 1 Ethereum. BlazarForce builds are always 137.
